page.overview:
Who is Belardo?

Belardo was one of the greatest of the Tilean master painters of the 22nd century IC, a genius in his own way.

Belardo was famously hired by the Von Carsteins to paint portraits of them, for which he was justly rewarded -- a mob burned him alive on top of a pyre made of his own works after the Battle of Hel Fenn in the public square of Talabheim. Someone betrayed him as he tried to pass through the city in secret.

Among his subjects was the Vampire known as Adolphus Krieger.

It is unknown whether Belardo or another painter created portraits of the Zmada family, and the artistic dispute was silenced when the Zmada family’s mansion burned to the ground. Only the Lady Zmada's Portrait survived. It passed into the collection of a private individual thereafter, and its current whereabouts are unknown.
